confidence_notes: FX: the RBA statistics table showed 0.6677 USD per AUD for 19 Nov 2026. The RBA overview page showed 0.6720 for 18 Nov, so the pages disagreed on which value is latest. I used the 19 Nov figure. Food and drink anchors come from one aggregated web search of Amalfi Coast cost guides. Those sources vary widely and mix bar-standing and seated prices, and some figures cover the wider Amalfi Coast rather than Amalfi town. Cocktail and wine are set from the search ranges and from typical Italian ratios to beer, not from direct Amalfi price data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, and I did not search accommodation prices. Amalfi has very few hostels, so the hostel anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Positano and Sorrento, discounted slightly from Positano and priced above typical Italian cities because of the coastal tourism premium.
